subject: Animation
title: Creature Comforts: Real Voices, Clay Bodies
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Creature Comforts: Real Voices, Clay Bodies.

hook.text: Nick Park recorded real people talking about their homes, then animated clay animals lip-syncing the words.

buildup.text: The mismatch between ordinary human complaints and charming animal puppets was hilarious and touching.

discovery.text: Creature Comforts won the Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film in 1990.

twist.text: The short was made as a student project. Park had no budget and used borrowed recording equipment.

climax.text: Creature Comforts proved that great animation does not require money — just a brilliant idea.

punchline.text: A student film with no budget won an Oscar.

quiz.question: What made Creature Comforts unique as an animated short?
options: It used CGI for the first time
It paired real human interview audio with clay animal characters lip-syncing the words
It was the first color stop-motion film
